description: This file defines a React component named EfSourceMappingTab that displays EF Source Mappings related to a specific asset and input parameter. It manages fetching data from an API, handles loading and error states, and renders a table with EF source mapping details. The component also provides UI feedback when no input parameter is selected and supports read-only mode based on user permissions.

methods.name: EfSourceMappingTab
methods.description: React component that displays EF Source Mappings for a selected input parameter, managing state, fetching data, and rendering the UI.
